title: Rumination spiral
prompt: I keep replaying a conversation from this morning, convinced I said something wrong and that everyone now secretly thinks I'm a bad person.
baselineRules: A thought is not a fact — replaying it changes nothing.
One awkward moment does not define what people think of me.
I cannot read minds; assuming the worst is a guess, not evidence.
Mentally reviewing the past is a loop, not problem-solving.
